correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the source definitions and exact minimizer equations. Eliminating the auxiliary variable gives \(a_{\mu,n}^2(1-b_{\mu,n})+((1-b_{\mu,n})/b_{\mu,n})^2=\mu^2\). The source limit \(b_{\mu,n}\to1\) makes the correction lower order, while fixed-order cylinder zero asymptotics imply \(a_{\mu,n}=\pi n+O(1)\). These facts rigorously yield \(1-b_{\mu,n}=\mu^2/(\pi^2n^2)+O(n^{-3})\). No experiment is promoted to proof.
